about: Player effects from the subsurface climate (user request 2026-10-26: the mechanism first, effects to be designed). Every intervalTicks, each survival or adventure player underground in a Riven world (below the crust's surface band, or in a realm below the crust floor) takes every effect whose conditions all hold at its feet. The effects below are a first, mild set to exercise the mechanism. This file ships as config/riven/player-effects.json, written on first run and never overwritten; the server reads that copy at start and on /riven effects reload. config/riven.cfg playerEffects turns the router off.
contract: when: every condition present must hold. celsius, humidity and air are [lowest, highest] ranges of the subsurface climate (riven-subsurface-climate.json); frozen and steam match its states; realms lists crust realms (skin, layered, basement, root) or realms below the crust floor (beneath, nether); depthBiomes lists crust depth biomes.
unless: the effect skips a player who has any of these potion effects.

potions: each is given for intervalTicks plus 30 ticks (so it holds while the condition does and fades soon after), as an ambient effect without particles; amplifier 0 is level I. exhaustionPerSecond adds food exhaustion at that rate.

Every key must be one listed here and every potion must be registered (any mod's, as namespace:name); a copy that breaks either, or is not valid JSON, is refused with the reason in the log and the command reply, and the effects in force stay.
Effects are gameplay, not generated content: changing this file needs no fresh world.
